facts.reason: Guard x0/x10 are float. Adding/subtracting one can round to unchanged for large finite values; strict progress is not unconditional.

Link and Young Link multiply the returned scalar by common velocity factor `x294`, sign it away from the recorded impact direction, and store it in `Fighter.gr_vel`.

Passive depletion triggers ShieldBreakFly only when shield health becomes strictly less than zero, then clamps it to zero.
